reproduction.agreement: Python and table agree (t 0.4956 vs 0.496, p .3139 vs .314, d .13). The R script today gives t 0.4928, p .3149: off by 0.003 in t. Cause: the per-subject means are multiples of 0.05, so mean/8 ends in an exact tie at the 4th decimal for most cells, and the script's round(., 3) resolves ties by the rounding algorithm, which R changed in 4.0.0. Exact half-even rounding gives 0.4956 (the table, and the value hard-coded in the replication team's own script, t = .4956); half-up gives 0.4984; no rounding gives 0.4944. All p in .313-.315.
